# Yay! Staking

**What is Yay! Staking?**

The Yay! Staking Campaign allows participants to earn various rewards, including protocol points, yields, Yay! Gold, and ???? point, based on their staking amount and duration. Besides Yay! Gold and ???? point, the protocol points earned will vary depending on the selected vault. 

Additionally, for inviting others to stake on Yay!, both the referrer and the invitee can earn additional rewards. Please see the [Rewards](https://yay.gitbook.io/yay-staking/yay-staking-intro/rewards) section for more information.

See Yay! Staking Campaign statistics here: <https://bit.ly/yay-stake>

**Available vaults**

* ETH staking
  * StakeStone
  * Kelp
* Astar staking
  * Sake (Astar v1) 
  * Neemo (Astar v2)

# FAQ

**FAQ**

<details>

<summary>What are yaySTONE, yayAgETH and yayASTR?</summary>

When you stake via the StakeStone and/or Kelp vault, you will receive a liquid staking token (LST) in return such as yaySTONE or yayAgETH representing your STONE or AgETH holdings at a 1-1 ratio. When you stake via Neemo (Astar v2) vault, you will recieve LST of yayASTR in return.

To learn more about STONE, see StakeStones guideline [here](https://docs.stakestone.io/stakestone/what-is-stone).

To learn more about AgETH, see Kelps guideline [here](https://kelp.gitbook.io/kelp/kelp-gain/airdrop-gain). 

To learn more about ASTR staking, see Neemo guideline [here](https://docs.neemo.finance/neemo/overview). 

</details>

<details>

<summary>Who is eligible to earn rewards?</summary>

By holding more than 0.00009 liquid staking tokens (e.g., yaySTONE, yayAgETH, yayASTR) through the vaults available on the Dashboard, anyone can earn Yay! Gold and ???? Points. For protocol points, generally, those holding the corresponding staking tokens are eligible to earn. Please check with our protocol partners for any specific limitations.

</details>

<details>

<summary>How can I earn referral rewards?</summary>

There are 2 ways to earn:

1. Join as an invitee and stake through other people’s referral code 
2. Refer others through your referral code and earn when they stake

</details>

<details>

<summary>What happens to my points when I unstake?</summary>

The impact on points upon unstaking may vary depending on the protocol, please check each protocol's regulations before unstaking. 

As for Yay! rewards:

* Yay! Gold: Your Yay! Gold balance remains in the wallet where it was earned.
* ???? point: After **January 16th, 15:00 JST**, your accumulated ???? Points will no longer reset to ZERO after unstaking. **Both your Yay! Gold and ???? Point balances will remain intact**, even if your yaySTONE or yayAgETH balance drops below 0.00009.

</details>

<details>

<summary>I staked with a referral code but I haven't received any referral rewards</summary>

Each referral code is only eligible to give referral rewards to the first 50 users who enter the code AND stake.

There may be a case where a referral code reaches the 50 referral limit while you are entering the referral code and staking. In this case, referral rewards will not apply. 

</details>

<details>

<summary>How frequent are points updated?</summary>

Yay! Rewards

* Yay! Gold: hourly
* ???? point: hourly

StakeStone Vault Rewards

* STONE-W1 points: by block 
* EigenLayer points: daily
* Symbiotic points: daily
* Mellow points: daily

Kelp Vault Rewards

* Kelp Miles: daily 
* Linea LXP-L: \~95 LXP-L/ETH/Day
* Scroll Marks: \~2.5 Marks/ETH/Day
* EigenLayer points: daily
* Karak XP: 460 XP/ETH/Day
* Kelp Infra Partner points: Coming Soon
* Circuit: Coming Soon
* Turtle Linea LXP-L: Coming Soon
* Turtle Kelp Miles: Coming Soon
* Turtle Linea Veteran: Coming Soon

Neemo (Astar v2) Vault Rewards

* Neemo point: hourly

</details>

<details>

<summary>What are Yay! Gold and ???? point?</summary>

For Yay! Gold, please see [here](https://portal.yay.space/airdrop). 

Details of ???? point will be revealed at a later time :shushing\_face:

</details>

<details>

<summary>Why are my Yay! Gold and ???? points not updating?</summary>

Yay! Gold and ???? point are distributed in decimal value but displayed in integers only. This means if your hourly rewards distribution is less than 1, your points will not be noticeable but rest assured you are accurately earning points.

</details>

<details>

<summary>What devices does the Yay! Staking Dashboard support? </summary>

The Dashboard is now supported on mobile devices; however, for the best experience and optimal functionality, we still recommend accessing our site from a desktop.

</details>

<details>

<summary>How are Yay! Gold and ???? point calculated?</summary>

Points are calculated hourly, using the the following two steps:

1. Vault allocation is determined based on the amount of ETH staked in that vault 

        Formula: vault allocation = 1,200 Yay! Gold \* % of total ETH staked in vault

        Formula: vault allocation = 375 ???? points\* % of total ETH staked in vault

2. User allocation is determined for distribution 

        Formula: user allocation = vault allocation \* % of user staking token holdings 

</details>

<details>

<summary>Why has my staked ETH amount decreased after staking in the Kelp Vault via the Yay! Dashboard?</summary>

The initial decrease in your staked ETH amount is due to the weekly calculation of management fees (2% per annum) and interest by Kelp Vault, which occurs on different days. Sometimes, the management fee may be deducted before the interest is applied, causing a temporary decrease in your staked amount. However, since the interest rate is designed to exceed the management fee over time, it is expected that your staked ETH amount will gradually increase. Please note that this increase is not guaranteed, and results may vary.

For more details, please refer to[ Kelp](https://kelpdao.xyz/gain/airdrop-gain/).

</details>

<details>

<summary>How long will it take for my staked ETH amount to potentially surpass the original amount for Kelp staking?</summary>

According to Kelp DAO, the staked ETH amount is expected to increase over time as interest accrues. Although Kelp DAO estimates that the staked amount could surpass the original staked amount within 2-3 weeks from the staking start date, this is not guaranteed and depends on various factors, including market conditions and the timing of interest and fee calculations.

For more details, please refer to[ Kelp](https://kelpdao.xyz/gain/airdrop-gain/).

</details>

<details>

<summary>When should I use the Redeem feature?</summary>

The Redeem feature is ideal if you want to convert your yaySTONE to Stone, yayAgETH to AgETH, or yayASTR to nsASTR instead of fully unstaking to ETH.

* Redeem Process: Comparing to unstaking, this conversion is instant. With Redeem feature, you will receive Stone, agETH, or nsASTR right after redeeming.

</details>

<details>

<summary>What happens to my points when I Redeem?</summary>

The impact on your rewards after redeeming depends on the protocol you’re using. We recommend reviewing the specific regulations for each protocol before proceeding. 

For Yay! rewards, here are a few key points:

• Yay! Gold: Your Yay! Gold balance remains in the wallet where it was earned.

• ???? Point: **After January 16th, 15:00 JST**, redeeming will no longer reset your accumulated ???? Points to zero.

Please note that you will stop earning both Yay! Gold and ???? Points If you redeem all your liquid staking tokens.

</details>

<details>

<summary>Which CEXs support ASTR EVM withdrawals?</summary>

Withdrawals can be made through the following CEXs and more. (as of December 2024)

* [Gate.io](https://www.gate.io/)
* [MEXC](https://www.mexc.com/)

</details>

# 2025-06-10: StakeStone Withdrawal Delay and New Cancel Option

The standard unstake process on the StakeStone Vault now takes significantly longer due to upstream changes by EigenLayer.

### Key Updates:

* **Withdrawal Time Extended:**\
  EigenLayer increased its normal unstake period from 7 to 14 days. Since StakeStone also needs to convert stETH to ETH via Lido (which adds another 14 days), the **total waiting period is now approximately 28+ days**.
* **Instant Unstake Available:**\
  We’re working with the StakeStone team to mitigate this problem, and they will periodically refill ETH in the instant unstake pool. Users can use instant unstake with no downside compared to request unstake—there is no need to wait through the extended unstake timeline.
* **Cancel Unstake Requests:**\
  A new feature now allows users to **cancel their existing unstake requests**. You can cancel and re-submit as an instant unstake if you prefer not to wait.

We understand this extended waiting period may cause inconvenience, and we appreciate your patience while we improve the experience. If you have any issues, feel free to reach out [here](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfjwm3vXTG9ELgVJ-j0fVgJZ2-R8h9fg-kv6qnIqVL_rw7CrA/viewform).

# 2025-09-26: Sunsetting of ASTR Vaults and yayASTR/ASTR LP

We sincerely thank all users who participated in ASTR staking through Yay!. Your support across both Sake (v1) and Neemo (v2) vaults, as well as the yayASTR/ASTR LP, has been greatly appreciated.

Starting from **October 1, 2025**, all *Yay! Gold* and *???? Points* distribution for ASTR-related products will end.

This includes:

* **WASTR Vault** (Sake v1)
* **vASTR Vault** (Sake v1)
* **yayASTR Vault** (Neemo v2)
* **yayASTR/ASTR LP**

### **Key Details**

* **No further points will be distributed** to these vaults or LP after *October 1, 2025*.
* **All users with remaining assets in these vaults or LP should withdraw their assets as soon as possible.**

#### **LP Access Still Available on Velodrome**

Although the yayASTR/ASTR LP UI will be removed from the Yay! Dashboard in early October, you can still manage your LP directly on Velodrome:

* [**LP**](https://velodrome.finance/deposit?token0=0x19a80f5dfe30bdf19054716e221539fc040f3b72\&token1=0x2cae934a1e84f693fbb78ca5ed3b0a6893259441\&type=1\&chain=1868\&factory=0x04625B046C69577EfC40e6c0Bb83CDBAfab5a55F\&chain0=1868\&chain1=1868)
* [**Swap yayASTR/ASTR**](https://velodrome.finance/swap?from=0x2cae934a1e84f693fbb78ca5ed3b0a6893259441\&to=0x19a80f5dfe30bdf19054716e221539fc040f3b72\&chain0=1868\&chain1=1868)

#### **ASTR Vault Visibility**

The ASTR vaults will remain visible on the Yay! Dashboard **only for users who still have staked assets**.\
These vaults will show a sunset notice and remain available for withdrawals.\
We will maintain them for a certain period of time and remove them in the future.

For more information on the **Neemo incident** and reimbursement process, please refer to: [Neemo Post-Mortem & Reimbursement Plan](https://yay.gitbook.io/yay-staking/updates/2025-08-27-neemo-finance-incident-post-mortem-and-reimbursement-plan)

If you need assistance with unstaking or withdrawing your assets, please contact us via: [Support Form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfjwm3vXTG9ELgVJ-j0fVgJZ2-R8h9fg-kv6qnIqVL_rw7CrA/viewform)

If the admin wants to reduce the delay, the old delay (7 days) should\n     * still apply for some time.\n     *\n     *\n     * The `Delay` type is 112 bits long, and packs the following:\n     *\n     * ```\n     *   | [uint48]: effect date (timepoint)\n     *   |           | [uint32]: value before (duration)\n     *   ↓           ↓       ↓ [uint32]: value after (duration)\n     * 0xAAAAAAAAAAAABBBBBBBBCCCCCCCC\n     * ```\n     *\n     * NOTE: The {get} and {withUpdate} functions operate using timestamps. Ethereum YayStoneToken at 0xe86142af1321eaac4270422081c1eda31eecff0c only; directly deployed, Sourcify creation/runtime exact_match and isProxy=false. Yay issues its own 18-decimal yaySTONE receipt and maintains its own burned-receipt withdrawal queue and settled ETH ledger over StakeStone, rather than merely labelling a StakeStone vault. This is one Yay! admission, not a second StakeStone admission.

stake(string) forwards positive msg.value ETH to the constructor-bound StakeStone vault and mints the returned STONE quantity to msg.sender; referralCode is event metadata only. A mutable aggregate ETH-denominated maxStakeLimit applies; share conversion is upstream and there is no caller minimum-share/slippage argument. Nonpayable methods require zero native value.

requestUnstake burns caller yaySTONE and queues the same STONE quantity in the current upstream round; adding requests updates the stored round. settleRequestedUnstakeIfNeeded(user) only credits that user after a later round exists, at historical round price with integer floor division by 1e18, then deletes that request. It neither pays the caller nor changes authority.

instantUnstake(ethAmount,stoneAmount) is not an unconditional instant redemption: source requires BOTH enough caller yaySTONE for stoneAmount and enough settled caller ethBalances for ethAmount, burns stoneAmount, debits ethAmount, and pays only the upstream actualWithdrawn ETH to caller. Upstream fee/liquidity/round conditions apply; arguments are not treated as an ERC4626 conversion or payout guarantee.

cancelUnstake first settles completed rounds, then cancels only the remaining caller requested STONE and re-mints that amount. redeemStoneTokens burns caller yaySTONE and returns the same amount of underlying STONE, not ETH. requestUnstake and redeemStoneTokens are AccessManaged restricted; observed authority 0x54e86315c03217b76a7466c302245fd10ebef25a canCall for arbitrary address 0x1 returned immediate=true, delay=0 for both selectors on 2026-10-24, not a permanent public-access guarantee. Catalog grants no role/scheduling capability.

Primary withdrawal notice describes roughly 28+ day normal waiting and periodically replenished instant liquidity; no payout date or complete ETH exit workflow is promised. Underlying StakeStone/STONE and access authority behavior remain dependencies, not independently attested here. Off-chain Yay Gold/points are not claimed on-chain and may have different eligibility than receipt accounting.

ASTR/Soneium vaults, bridges, LPs, rewards/airdrop and Kelp routes are not admitted. ASTR sunset notice is explicitly limited to those products; it is not evidence of Ethereum yaySTONE retirement. Approvals/transfers, authority changes, emergency withdrawals, cap administration, and non-view price/estimate helpers are excluded.
